Child '''Oratar''' is a member of the [[Children of the Light]].

== Appearance ==
Orator is young and bald. He is short a little plumb around the middle and he has a long nose that is pointed like a beak, and his nose has bean broken many times.

== Activities ==
He was present when [[Perrin Aybara]] killed two other members of the Children of the Light. {{ref/book|1|30}} He confirms [[Jaret Byar]]'s account of the murder at Perrin's trial.
